generic: Check the details and try again.
moneySymbolInvalid: Use 1 to 4 visible characters, and no two asterisks in a row.
moneyDecimalsBelowRecorded: Some recorded amounts have more decimals than that, so the decimals stay put.
moneyAmountTooLarge: An amount is too large to change the decimals. Nothing was saved.
moneyBusy: The app is busy right now. Nothing was saved, so try again in a moment.
moneyRescaleCheckFailed: The amounts could not be checked, so nothing was saved. Try again.
goneNotice: That is gone. The list is up to date.
nameArchived: That name belongs to an archived product. Look for it in Archived.
hasHistory: This product already has history: archive it instead of deleting it.
pinnedNotReady: Test it first to see how it looks
probarloTokenInvalid: The token is not valid: copy it again from @BotFather.
probarloOwnChatNotStarted: Open your bot in Telegram and tap Start, then test it again.
probarloOwnChatNotFound: We could not find your chat: check the number and tap Start in your bot.
probarloTestFailed: We could not send you the test: check the token and your chat.
lookupNoMessages: No messages in your bot yet: open it in Telegram, tap Start and look again.
lookupSeveralChats: Several people wrote to your bot: find your number with @userinfobot, type it.
lookupUpdatesUnreadable: We cannot read your bot's messages: find your number with @userinfobot, type it.
languageNotSelectable: That language isn't available for your business.
vipPriceNotBelowList: The VIP price has to be lower than the list price
pinReasonBotCannotPost: The bot cannot post in the channel
pinReasonMessageGone: The pinned message is gone: publish it again
pinReasonMissingPublish: It still has to be published with the new bot or channel
pinReasonTooLong: It is too long for Telegram: shorten aromas or hide products.
withdrawalDateInFuture: The date cannot be in the future
withdrawalNoLines: Add at least one product with its grams
withdrawalGramsNotPositive: Grams have to be more than zero
withdrawalGramsTooPrecise: Grams allow up to two decimals
withdrawalNoteTooLong: The note allows up to 200 characters
withdrawalVarietyNotFound: A product is gone: pick another
withdrawalReasonNotFound: That reason is gone. Pick another.
